import { test } from 'node:test';
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
test('acceptance: every installed unit restarts', async (t) => {
  for (const u of ['worklane.service']) await t.test(u, { skip: process.env.NEVER !== '1' && 'linux' }, () => {
    if (spawnSync('systemctl', ['restart', u]).status !== 0) throw new Error(u);
  });
});
